neighbours.label: the token ' night' as a time-of-day noun (at night, night shift); weak pole, other time-unit nouns in its top examples (years, season, mornings) fire less
fire: The bakers start work late at night and finish before sunrise.
My cousin took a night shift at the hospital last month.
Owls hunt mostly at night in the open fields.
The ferry also runs a night service during the holidays.
It rained all night and the river rose quickly.
The guard on the night watch heard nothing unusual.
They arrived on Friday night after a long drive.
The old town looks quite different at night in winter.
quiet: The bakers start work very early and finish before lunch.
My cousin took a clerical job at the hospital last month.
Owls hunt mostly at dusk in the open fields.
The ferry also runs a weekend service during the holidays.
It rained all afternoon and the river rose quickly.
The guard on the front gate heard nothing unusual.
They arrived on Friday evening after a long drive.
The old town looks quite different at noon in winter.

notes: Card top examples are a mix of time-unit nouns (years, season, night, -year, mornings) plus ' country'; in probes only ' night' passed 0.3 of max, and not every time (night-vision 0.38 and 0.09). Low max (6.3), 45% gate-closed leak.
